quote.text: @VoidStateKate I had a dream the jester queen banished me from the brewing realm. I smiled wide and packed my 41 lighters and an old electric typewriter and set off on foot with cloak and dagger in the cool of night. A heard of curious antelope led me into the wilderness where I could think.
